experiments.title: Compare orbital periods
experiments.instruction: Predict which completes more of its orbit in one Earth year: Earth or Neptune. Select your prediction, then Advance one Earth year.
experiments.observe: Earth completes 1 orbit and Neptune about 1/165. Explain why equal elapsed time does not mean equal orbital fractions.

experiments.title: Compare diameters
experiments.instruction: Predict how many Earth diameters fit across Jupiter. Choose Jupiter, then View: True diameter comparison. Keep the same view while comparing other planets.
experiments.observe: Jupiter spans about 11.21 Earth diameters. Explain why the separate close-up cannot establish this ratio.
